name: smwmusic-donkey-kong-country
title: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest - Mercy is for Monkeys! 🏴‍☠️ ~ Crocodile Cacophony (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫, 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐲 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐫
𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐄𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐦𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐰! ❞
ㅤ- King K. Rool, Donkey Kong Country Cartoon (1998)



Did an arrangement of Crocodile Cacophony from the GREATEST GAME EVER MADE!! Did his first theme song last year, so I HAVE TO do his true theme song!!! Took heavy inspiration from both the original and Smash renditions.

Important:
ㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. G Major (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A Major (Croc Isle Pitch)
ㅤ3. G# Major (Finest Hour Pitch)
ㅤ4. F Major (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ5. F# Major (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Volume Level (OG Volume)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Volume Level (LOWER Volume)ㅤ[turned on by default]
